name: 梁斯寧
objective: This course familiarizes students with qualitative and quantitative research procedures and design involved in education and applied linguistics research. Topics will include the nature and process of research; survey research; experimental research; sampling, data collection and data analysis.

Week 8: Interviews
Week 9: Mid-term assessment
and 10: Mixed methods research
Week 11: Mixed methods research
Week 12: Quiz 2
Week 13: Text and discourse analysis
Week 14: Conversation analysis (by Prof Andrew Chuang)
Week 15: Discourse analysis ((by Prof Andrew Chuang)
Week 16: Cognitive approaches to text & discourse (by Prof Andrew Chuang)

name: 莊惠鈞
objective:
本門課之目的是讓學生熟悉質與量研究方法的設計。主題涵蓋研究計劃之準備及撰擬 ;主要研究方法，如調查研究法、相關研究法、實驗研究法、行動研究法；質性和量化資料之搜集與分析；敘述統計和推論統計。
This course familiarizes students with qualitative and quantitative research procedures and the statistical design involved in education and applied linguistics research. Topics will include the nature and process of research; survey research; experimental research; correlational research; action research; data collection and data analysis; descriptive statistics; and sampling and inferential statistics.
課程進度(1-16週):
[Tentative Schedule]

Andrew will be covering selected approaches to text and discourse analysis at an introductory level from a cognitive-functional perspective, including Conversation Analysis (CA), Discourse Analysis (DA), and cognitive approaches to meaning construction such as conceptual metaphor and framing.
________________________

W14 (Dec 7) Conversation Analysis (CA): Interaction and Sequential Organization

W15 (Dec 14) Discourse Analysis (DA): Context, Meaning, and Social Positioning

W16 (Dec 21) Cognitive Approaches to Text & Discourse: Metaphor and Framing
